title: highline179 Hängebrücke Reutte
highlights: Eine der laengsten Fussgaengerhaengebruecken der Welt im Tibet-Stil mit 406 Metern Spannweite
Schwindelerregende 114 Meter freischwebend ueber der Fernpassstrasse B179
Spektakulaere Verbindung zwischen der Burgruine Ehrenberg und dem Fort Claudia
360-Grad-Aussicht auf die Lechtaler Alpen und den Talkessel von Reutte
kurzbeschreibung: The highline179 near Reutte spans across the valley at 406 meters in length and 114 meters in height as a thrilling suspension bridge.
beschreibung:
Thrills Between Two Historic Fortresses

The highline179 serves as a daring pedestrian suspension bridge linking the historic Burgruine Ehrenberg with Fort Claudia on the opposite slope. With a span of 406 meters and a soaring clearance of 114 meters, this cable structure offers an unparalleled sensation of floating on air.

Valley Vistas and Alpine Peak Panoramas

Featuring a transparent open-grate floor, walking across the bridge is an unforgettable adventure for all the senses. Visitors enjoy dramatic 360-degree views across the forested slopes of the Ausserfern and the striking summits of the Allgaeuer Alpen.
